2607.25507.title: Phase Structure in Rotary Attention: A Spectral Framework for Semantic Continuity and Execution-Boundary Governance
2607.25507.paper_summary: Transformer language models are usually analyzed through vector geometry, yet ordered context and rotary position encoding introduce explicit phase structure into query-key interactions. This paper develops a bounded spectral framework for examining rotary phase alignment, hidden-state continuity, and semantic drift without treating language models as literal physical wave systems. It first identifies ordered hidden-state sequences, rather than vocabulary indices, as valid domains for spectral decomposition. It then derives the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) attention score as a sum of magnitude-weighted cosine terms and proves a local stability lemma: uniformly bounded phase displacement limits degradation of the corresponding pre-softmax score. To extend phase analysis beyond native RoPE coordinates, the paper defines complex modal coordinates over fixed orthonormal direction pairs and introduces a weighted coherence functional for hidden-state trajectories. These constructions support a strict distinction between representational continuity and execution-boundary admissibility. Internal coherence may describe preservation of task-relevant relations, but it cannot authorize a consequential transition. Positioned against existing geometric, spectral, phase-modulation, representation-analysis, and mechanistic-interpretability accounts, the framework contributes a theoretical and methodological program for determining when spectral structure explains continuity and when governance must remain an external predicate over execution.
2607.25507.paper_summary_zh: Transformer語言模型通常通過向量幾何進行分析，但有序上下文和旋轉位置編碼在查詢-鍵互動中引入了明確的相位結構。本文開發了一個有界譜框架，用於檢查旋轉相位對齊、隱藏狀態連續性和語義漂移，而不將語言模型視為字面上的物理波系統。它首先確定有序的隱藏狀態序列，而不是詞彙索引，作為譜分解的有效領域。然後，它推導出旋轉位置嵌入（RoPE）注意力分數，作為幅度加權餘弦項的總和，並證明了一個局部穩定性引理：均勻有界的相位位移限制了相應的預軟最大分數的退化。為了擴展相位分析超越原生的 RoPE 坐標，本文在固定的正交方向對上定義了複數模態坐標，並為隱藏狀態軌跡引入了加權一致性泛函。這些構造支持了表徵連續性和執行邊界可接受性之間的嚴格區分。內部一致性可以描述任務相關關係的保留，但它不能授權一個重要的轉變。在現有的幾何、譜、相位調製、表徵分析和機械可解釋性賬戶的背景下，該框架為確定何時譜結構解釋連續性以及何時治理必須保持外部前提提供了一個理論和方法論計劃。
2607.25507.author: Abraham Chachamovits et.al.
